description.en:
Even the slightest change to ARC's behavior could spell disaster.

And that signal you heard? It's like nothing we've ever picked up. If they're up to something, we need to find out whatever we can.
description.zh-CN:
即使ARC行为最微小的改变也可能意味着灾难。

你听到的那个信号，跟我们以前接收到的任何信号都不同。如果它们有什么企图，我们必须尽可能调查清楚。

objectives.en: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier
objectives.zh-CN: 找到并搜索ARC探测器或ARC运输机

description.en: Our food production is finally enough to meet our basic needs, but what we really need now is variety. I have a lead on some agricultural research from before the First Wave. Are you in?
description.zh-CN: 我们的食物生产终于足以满足我们的基本需求了，但现在真正需要的是多样化。我有一些关于“第一波”之前的农业研究的线索。有兴趣吗？

objectives.en: Go to the Research & Administration building
objectives.zh-CN: 前往研究与行政区大楼

objectives.en: Locate Lab 1 on the upper floor above the reception
objectives.zh-CN: 找到接待前台上方楼层的1号实验室

objectives.en: Search for any traces of the agricultural research project
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找农业研究项目的蛛丝马迹

description.en: We're short on everything but mouths to feed, yet Celeste's launching precious supplies into the air for Raiders to claw over. I’m done letting the good stuff go to waste.
description.zh-CN: 除了不缺吃饭的嘴巴，我们啥都缺。但是塞莱斯特依然把宝贵的补给发到上头去给奇袭者使用。好东西就这样浪费，我忍不了。

objectives.en: Request in a Supply Drop from a Call Station
objectives.zh-CN: 在补给呼叫站请求补给

objectives.en: Loot a Supply Drop
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮一个补给投放点

description.en:
I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing.

That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?
description.zh-CN:
我……我不明白。前一天他们还在努力阻止“大崩溃”，然后，突然就……什么都没了。

那个抗震住宅工程被一个叫螫蝎的组织叫停了。你能去查查更多线索吗？

objectives.en: Find MANTIKOR's underground facilities
objectives.zh-CN: 找到螫蝎的地下设施

objectives.en: Find a way into into the locked room in the Security Wing
objectives.zh-CN: 设法进入安保区辅楼的上锁房间

objectives.en: Search the locked room for any records on Project Heartwood
objectives.zh-CN: 在上锁房间中搜寻关于“常青计划”的记录

objectives.en: Find the Dusty Film Reel
objectives.zh-CN: 找到布满灰尘的电影胶卷

objectives.en: Deliver the Dusty Film Reel to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将布满灰尘的电影胶卷交给萨尼

description.en:
We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest.

My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.
description.zh-CN: 我们刚把暗道网络扩展到蓝门附近，其他路段还在加紧施工。我的小队正在山谷周边修建新基础设施来保护奇袭者，但ARC持续不断的威胁让工程举步维艰。

objectives.en: Stabilize the observation deck near the Ridgeline
objectives.zh-CN: 稳定山脊线附近的观测台

objectives.en: Enable the comms terminal near the Olive Grove
objectives.zh-CN: 启动橄榄树林附近的通讯终端

objectives.en: Rotate the satellite dishes on the church roof, north of the Data Vault
objectives.zh-CN: 转动数据仓库北边教堂屋顶的卫星天线

objectives.en: Nail down the roof plates on the Raider structure near Trapper's Glade
objectives.zh-CN: 固定猎人林地附近奇袭者建筑屋顶的钢板

description.en:
Those distant rumbles are getting less distant with each passing day.

I have a lead on some LiDAR scanners that may help us monitor the tremors. You do want to keep a roof over your head, don’t you?
description.zh-CN: 轰隆声越来越近了。搞到激光雷达扫描仪就能监测地震，我知道它们在哪。你总不想睡着睡着天塌了吧？

objectives.en: Reach the Jiangsu Warehouse
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达江苏仓库

objectives.en: Find the shipping notes in the foreman’s office
objectives.zh-CN: 在施工负责人办公室找到货运单据

objectives.en: Locate the scanners in the Flight Control office of Control Tower A6
objectives.zh-CN: 在控制塔A6的飞控中心办公室找到扫描仪

objectives.en: Deliver 1 LiDAR Scanners to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 把1台激光雷达扫描仪交给萨尼

description.en: Some scouts have been bringing back reports of these weird plants spreading into the area. Now, this makes your old pal Lance think it may have some interesting uses.
description.zh-CN: 一些侦察者带回报告，说有些奇怪的植物正蔓延到本区域。你的老伙计兰斯听完就觉得，这种植物可能有些有趣的用途。

objectives.en: Search for the new plant near the Baron Husk in the Old Battleground
objectives.zh-CN: 在旧战场的“男爵”残骸附近寻找新植物

objectives.en: Deliver the Possibly Toxic Plant to Lance
objectives.zh-CN: 将可能有毒的植物交给兰斯

description.en: Before our paths changed, we lingered by the Blue Gate for some time. We believe there is an old trail from those days, and something belonging to us may still lie at its end.
description.zh-CN: 在命运转折之前，我们曾在蓝门逗留过一段时间。我们认为当年有一条古道，道路尽头或许还留着属于我们的东西。

objectives.en: Find the start of the Nomad trail under the Highway Collapse
objectives.zh-CN: 在高速公路崩塌区下方找到游民路径的起点

objectives.en: Follow the trail markers to the Nomad hideout
objectives.zh-CN: 沿着路径标记前往游民藏身处

objectives.en: Find Bilguun's gift at the buried cache under the hideout
objectives.zh-CN: 在藏身处下方的埋藏储物箱中找到比尔根的礼物

objectives.en: Loot the secret stash in Bilguun's hideout
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮比尔根藏身处的秘密储备箱

objectives.en: Deliver the Broken Compass to the Nomadic Envoy
objectives.zh-CN: 将破损罗盘交付给游牧使团

description.en: That Deforester by the Blue Gate may have caused some real devastation, but a pristine husk like that is also an invaluable sample for our research.
description.zh-CN: 蓝门旁边的那个“伐木手”造成了不少的破坏，但那样完好的残骸也是我们研究中的无价样本。

objectives.en: Obtain 2 ARC Powercells
objectives.zh-CN: 获得2个ARC能量电池

objectives.en: Interact with any ARC Deforester
objectives.zh-CN: 与任意ARC“伐木手”互动

objectives.en: Loot an ARC Deforester
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮一个ARC“伐木手”

description.en: I got my hands on a fancy new ESR analyzer; had a whole big reveal planned. One minute it’s here, next minute—poof. Please help?
description.zh-CN: 我搞到了一台崭新的ESR分析仪。本来计划来个大揭秘的，但是突然之间就不见了。能帮帮忙吗？

objectives.en: Search for an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in Buried City
objectives.zh-CN: 到掩埋废城的任意药店中搜索ESR分析仪

objectives.en: Deliver the ESR Analyzer to Lance
objectives.zh-CN: 把ESR分析仪交给兰斯

description.en: Says here there was a foreman at The Dam, who got recruited right after they canceled Project Heartwood. Got put in charge of some big reconstruction project.
description.zh-CN: 记录上说，大坝那边有个工头，是在“常青计划”取消后招募的。负责某个大型重建项目。

objectives.en: On Buried City, find the foreman's barricaded apartment south of Piazza Roma
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城的罗马广场南部找到设下障碍的工头公寓

objectives.en: Access the foreman's digital logbook
objectives.zh-CN: 访问工头的数字日志

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, reach the Power Generation Complex
objectives.zh-CN: 前往大坝战场的发电厂综合体

objectives.en: Find a way into the Controlled Access Zone
objectives.zh-CN: 设法进入受控访问区

objectives.en: Search the Controlled Access Zone for any clues about the foreman's reconstruction project
objectives.zh-CN: 在受控访问区搜寻关于工头重建项目的线索

description.en: Y’know, back in the day we actually used to have a flag - well, a scrap of cloth more than anything. Still, seeing it meant you knew you had allies nearby, that you were on your own home turf. So, I was thinking…
description.zh-CN: 话说，早年我们真有一面旗子——好吧，算是块破布。但看见它就代表附近有战友，算到了自家地盘。所以我在想……

objectives.en: Reach the Formicai Outpost in Dam Battlegrounds
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达大坝战场的蚁丘山哨站

objectives.en: Locate the flag at the Formicai Outpost
objectives.zh-CN: 在蚁丘山哨站找到旗帜

objectives.en: Hoist the flag on the small platform overlooking the Red Lake
objectives.zh-CN: 在俯瞰红湖的小平台上扬起旗帜

description.en: We've got clean water again, but we can't risk people falling ill if the saboteurs return. We need to root them out once and for all.
description.zh-CN: 我们虽已恢复净水供应，但要是破坏者卷土重来，绝不能冒险让人染病。必须彻底铲除他们。

objectives.en: Return to the water intake below the Water Treatment Control building
objectives.zh-CN: 返回水处理控制中心大楼下方的供水口

objectives.en: Search the swamp for traces of the barrel's origins
objectives.zh-CN: 在沼泽中搜寻油桶来源的痕迹

objectives.en: Take a photo of the barrel truck
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄油桶卡车的照片

objectives.en: Search the truck for clues about the saboteur's identity
objectives.zh-CN: 搜索卡车以寻找关于破坏者身份的线索

description.en: A customer of mine saw a family taking cover in an old encampment in Buried City. I'll pay anyone who manages to find them and escort them back to safety.
description.zh-CN: 我的一个客户看到有一家人在掩埋废城中的一个旧营地中避难。谁要是能找到并护送他们回到安全地带，可以到我这来领赏。

objectives.en: Locate the Abandoned Highway Camp
objectives.zh-CN: 找到废弃的高速公路营地

objectives.en: Search for any signs of survivors
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找幸存者的痕迹

objectives.en: Follow the red markers
objectives.zh-CN: 追踪红色标记

objectives.en: Inspect the grave
objectives.zh-CN: 检查坟墓

description.en: Looks like the resentment ended up reaching the ground staff of the Spaceport itself. A mutiny brewing, right in the heart of the Exodus.
description.zh-CN: 看来不满情绪蔓延到了太空港的地勤员工，“离巢”的核心地带正在酝酿叛乱。

objectives.en: Search the buses near the western gate
objectives.zh-CN: 搜索西门附近的巴士

objectives.en: Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers
objectives.zh-CN: 找到藏在水塔的破坏物资储备箱

description.en: The Hairpin wastes very little motion between shots. That sort of efficiency gets more interesting once a scope is involved.
description.zh-CN: “发夹”的射击间隙动作极小，这种高效率要是配上瞄准镜，潜力会更大。

objectives.en: Deal 1000 damage with a Hairpin
objectives.zh-CN: 使用“发夹”造成1000点伤害

label.zh-CN: 使用“发夹”造成1000点伤害

description.en:
I know, I know! The power's down in sector—
Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long.

Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?
description.zh-CN:
我知道，我知道！有个地区的电源被切断了……
哦，嗨。一场突发洪水摧毁了我们在掩埋废城的一些太阳能面板，偏偏发电机又快要撑不住了。

如果你到了那边，能不能帮我们修理一下？

objectives.en: Find the flooded solar panels nearby the Grandioso Apartments
objectives.zh-CN: 到奢华公寓附近找到被洪水摧毁的太阳能面板

objectives.en: Repair the solar panels using 5 Wires and 2 Batteries
objectives.zh-CN: 使用5根电线和2块电池修理太阳能面板

description.en:
Ever since we expanded the tunnels to the Blue Gate, some rare pieces have started appearing on the black market.

Meanwhile, I'm stuck here peddling battered old Rattlers. If I don't find new supply lines, I'll be left in the dust.
description.zh-CN: 自从我们将地道扩展到蓝门以来，黑市上开始出现一些稀有零件。与此同时，我却困在这里兜售老掉牙的“响尾蛇”。如果不找到新的供应线，我就要被市场淘汰了。

objectives.en: Reach the Checkpoint
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达检查站

objectives.en: Search the Guard huts for an Armored Patrol Key Card
objectives.zh-CN: 在警卫室搜索装甲巡逻车钥匙卡

objectives.en: Reach the Traffic Tunnel near the Blue Gate Checkpoint
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达蓝门检查站附近的通行隧道

objectives.en: Find a spare Armored Patrol Car Key Card
objectives.zh-CN: 找到备用的装甲巡逻车钥匙卡

objectives.en: Find and unlock the rear door of an armored patrol car
objectives.zh-CN: 找到并解锁装甲巡逻车的后门

description.en: Guess what? Shani asked me to help out with something, and for once, I’m actually glad she did. We’re setting up new outposts topside! Or, planning to, at least. Can you believe it?
description.zh-CN: 猜怎么着？萨尼请我帮忙办点事，这次我居然挺高兴的。我们要在上层建立新的哨站了！或者说，至少是计划要建。你敢信吗？

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, mark the Pattern House
objectives.zh-CN: 在大坝战场标记壁画屋

objectives.en: On The Blue Gate, mark the white lookout tower south of the Warehouse Complex
objectives.zh-CN: 在蓝门标记仓储综合区以南的白色瞭望塔

objectives.en: On Spaceport, mark the South Trench Tower
objectives.zh-CN: 在太空港标记南壕沟塔

objectives.en: On Buried City, mark the building with the mural in the Buried Properties
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城标记掩埋地产内带壁画的建筑

description.en: Tough nuts to crack, those Bullies. But you know, nothing’s indestructible. I’ve heard of a few tricks that might just work, care to put them to a test?
description.zh-CN: “恶霸”是块难啃的骨头。但话说回来，没有什么是坚不可摧的。我听说有几个法子可能管用，要不要试试？

objectives.en: Destroy a Bully
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“恶霸”

objectives.en: Destroy the head of a Bully
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“恶霸”的头部

objectives.en: Destroy 4 Bully legs
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁4个“恶霸”腿部

objectives.en: Deliver a Bully Fragmenter to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将1枚“恶霸”破片弹交付给阿波罗

label.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“恶霸”
摧毁1个“恶霸”

description.en: We’d hoped the seawalls at Riven Tides might offer us some protection from the elements, but it seems the hurricanes were not kind to this place, either.
description.zh-CN: 我们本指望裂潮镇的海堤能抵御天灾，可飓风也没放过这里。

objectives.en: Photograph the cracks forming in the seawall
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄海堤上的裂缝

objectives.en: Sample the shoreline near the hotel beach
objectives.zh-CN: 在酒店海滩附近的海岸线采集样本

objectives.en: Fix the leaking oil pipe in the northeast
objectives.zh-CN: 修复东北部的漏油管道

description.en: The Equalizer is at its best when the beam stays exactly where the target would rather not have it. Maybe we can work with that.
description.zh-CN: “制裁者”的激光只要死死黏在目标的要害上，就能发挥最大威力。或许我们可以从这点入手作进一步优化。

objectives.en: Deal 1500 damage to Vaporizers with an Equalizer in one round
objectives.zh-CN: 单局内使用“制裁者”对“汽化者”造成1500点伤害

label.en: Deal 1500 damage to Vaporizers with an Equalizer in one round
label.zh-CN: 单局内使用“制裁者”对“汽化者”造成1500点伤害

description.en: Bees! There are bees still around! While I’m no expert, our greenhouse crew desperately wants some.
description.zh-CN: 蜜蜂！蜜蜂居然没有灭绝！虽然我不是专家，但我们的温室团队非常想要。

objectives.en: Reach the Olive Grove in Blue Gate
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达蓝门区域的橄榄树林

objectives.en: Search for bee hives around the Olive Grove
objectives.zh-CN: 在橄榄树林附近寻找蜂巢

description.en: ARC’s been swarming that fallen Emperor like flies on honey. I’m picking up signals from far beyond the Rust Belt, and they’re not slowing down.
description.zh-CN: ARC围着那台坠毁的“帝王”机器，像苍蝇叮着蜂蜜一样。我检测到了远自锈带之外的信号，而且数量还在增加。

objectives.en: Acquire an Emperor Gateway Conduit
objectives.zh-CN: 获取“帝王”通道导管

objectives.en: Enter the Emperor
objectives.zh-CN: 进入“帝王”机器

objectives.en: Find where the power inside the Emperor comes from
objectives.zh-CN: 查明“帝王”机器内部的动力来源

objectives.en: Find out what happens to the Harvester Payloads that enter the Emperor
objectives.zh-CN: 查明送入“帝王”机器的“收割者”空投去向

objectives.en: Find where the Harvester Payloads sent to the Emperor are stored
objectives.zh-CN: 查明送往“帝王”机器的“收割者”空投存放处

objectives.en: Search 5 containers inside the Emperor
objectives.zh-CN: 在“帝王”内部搜查5个容器

objectives.en: Obtain a unique piece of Emperor loot
objectives.zh-CN: 获得1件独特的“帝王”机器战利品

description.en:
None of our old tactics work, facing those Frigates. We can’t run. We can’t hide. And there’s no waiting them out.

We need to take bold action, and we need to do it now.
description.zh-CN: 面对那些“护卫者”，我们的老战术全都不管用。跑不掉，躲不了，耗也耗不起。我们必须大胆行动，而且刻不容缓。

objectives.en: Find a way on top of the Frigate
objectives.zh-CN: 设法登上“护卫者”顶部

objectives.en: Damage a Hydra
objectives.zh-CN: 击伤1个“九头蛇”

objectives.en: Damage a Vaporizer
objectives.zh-CN: 击伤1个“汽化者”

objectives.en: Damage a Rocketeer
objectives.zh-CN: 击伤1个“火箭手”

label.en: Establish a foothold on top of the Frigate
label.zh-CN: 在“护卫者”顶部建立立足点

description.en: Now, time to see if that recon paid off. If we can teach Raiders to effectively counter Bombardiers up there, we’d be a lot safer down here.
description.zh-CN: 现在，是时候看看侦察的成果了。如果我们能教会奇袭者有效对抗天上的“投弹手”，我们在地下的安全就能大大提升。

objectives.en: Destroy a Bombardier
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“投弹手”

objectives.en: Deliver a Bombardier Cell to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将一个“投弹手”电池交给萨尼

description.en: I have another special site I need you to search for me. An old battlegrounds, from the First Wave. Raiders nowadays usually pick places like that clean, despite the significance they once held. People forget quickly. Quicker than they should.
description.zh-CN: 我还有个特殊地点要你帮我找，是“第一波”时期的老战场。虽然这种地方具有重要意义，但如今的奇袭者通常会将之扫荡一空。人们遗忘得太快，快得有些不应该。

objectives.en: Reach the hallowed grounds by the Scrap Yard
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达废料场旁边的圣地

objectives.en: Search for a compass near the broken-down vehicles
objectives.zh-CN: 在报废车辆附近寻找指南针

objectives.en: Deliver First Wave Compass to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 把“第一波”指南针交给天玟

objectives.en: Search for the video tape near the cylindrical containers
objectives.zh-CN: 在圆柱形容器附近寻找录像带

objectives.en: Deliver the First Wave Tape to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 把“第一波”磁带交给天玟

objectives.en: Search for the old field rations in the Raider camp
objectives.zh-CN: 在奇袭者营地搜寻旧的野战口粮

objectives.en: Deliver First Wave Rations to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 把“第一波”口粮交给天玟

description.en: Our library selection has grown pretty stale. Could you head out to Buried City, and find something more for us to read? Make sure you bring something for everyone.
description.zh-CN: 我们的图书室藏书已经相当陈旧了。拜托你去掩埋废城找找，带点新书回来。记得多带点不同种类的。

objectives.en: Locate the Library in the City Center
objectives.zh-CN: 在市中心找到图书馆

objectives.en: Find 1 romance book
objectives.zh-CN: 找到1本言情小说

objectives.en: Find 1 detective book
objectives.zh-CN: 找到1本侦探小说

objectives.en: Find 1 adventure book
objectives.zh-CN: 找到1本冒险小说

objectives.en: Deliver 3 books to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将3本书交给阿波罗

description.en: Shredders manage rapid volleys with little downtime. Careful dismantling with a Raider Tool might preserve the firing assembly long enough to figure out how.
description.zh-CN: “粉碎者”能实现高速连射，间隔极短。用奇袭工具小心拆解，或许能完整保留发射组件，摸清其原理。

objectives.en: Destroy 3 Shredders with a Raider Tool
objectives.zh-CN: 使用奇袭工具摧毁3个“粉碎者”

label.zh-CN: 连发组件复原

description.en:
Say, pal, has Celeste seemed a bit down, to you? 

Listen, I think I know something that might brighten her day. Do you know the hotel around Riven Tides?
description.zh-CN: 我说朋友，你有没有觉得塞莱斯特最近有点消沉？听着，我知道有件事或许能让她开心点。你知道裂潮镇附近的那家酒店吗？

objectives.en: Find young Celeste’s room in Hotel Panorama Azzurro
objectives.zh-CN: 在蔚蓝全景酒店找到塞莱斯特少年时住的房间

objectives.en: Search for anything significant in Celeste's Room
objectives.zh-CN: 在塞莱斯特的房间搜寻任何有重要意义的物品

objectives.en: Find the drawing on the roof of the third Customs House
objectives.zh-CN: 找到第三座海关大楼屋顶的画作

objectives.en: Find the drawing at the Quay
objectives.zh-CN: 找到船舶码头处的画作

label.en: Search each location marked on the map
label.zh-CN: 搜索地图上标记的每一处地点

description.en: Okay, so this is awkward… I lost two of my journals during some outpost inspections last time I went topside. Could you head out there and try to find them back before someone else stumbles on them?
description.zh-CN: 说起来有点尴尬……上次我去上层进行哨站检查时丢了两本日记。你能去帮忙找回来吗？我不想日记落到别人手里。

objectives.en: Retrieve Celeste’s Journals from the South Swamp Outpost
objectives.zh-CN: 从沼泽南部岗哨取回塞莱斯特的日记

objectives.en: Retrieve Celeste’s Journals from Raider Outpost East
objectives.zh-CN: 从奇袭者岗哨东侧取回塞莱斯特的日记

objectives.en: Deliver 2 Journals to Celeste
objectives.zh-CN: 将2本日记交给塞莱斯特

description.en:
Those Frigates looming in the sky… It made me feel shivers I haven’t felt since I was a girl. 

We need to adapt, I know. But the lessons we learned then? They're more relevant now than ever.
description.zh-CN: 那些悬在天上的“护卫者”……让我突然记起了小时候那种不寒而栗的感觉。我知道我们得随机应变，但当年吸取的教训，现在比任何时候都受用。

objectives.en: Reach the lookout tower on Mulatierra Hill
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达中央山丘的瞭望塔

objectives.en: Transmit the location from the top of the tower
objectives.zh-CN: 从塔顶传输位置信息

objectives.en: Spot 3 ARC from the Lookout Tower
objectives.zh-CN: 从瞭望塔发现3个ARC单位

objectives.en: Reach the old Raider Camp near the hotel, overlooking the beach
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达海滩观景酒店附近的旧奇袭者营地

objectives.en: Search for a radio transmitter at the Raider Camp
objectives.zh-CN: 在奇袭者营地搜寻无线电发射器

objectives.en: Find the large antenna overlooking Riven Tides harbor
objectives.zh-CN: 找到俯瞰裂潮镇港口的大型天线

objectives.en: Weld the broken generator
objectives.zh-CN: 焊接损坏的发电机

objectives.en: Start the transmitter
objectives.zh-CN: 启动发射器

description.en: I think I've found something we might exploit. When bigger ARC machines are just far enough from each other, a well-timed distraction could pull one out of position. You want to test that idea?
description.zh-CN: 我发现了一个可利用的点。当大型ARC机器彼此距离足够远时，一次恰到好处的干扰就能让其中一台脱离站位。想测试这个想法吗？

objectives.en: Use 3 Wires to repair and sound the emergency siren by the Warehouse Complex
objectives.zh-CN: 使用3根电线修复并鸣响仓储综合区旁的紧急警报器

objectives.en: Use a Battery to start the boom box in the Village
objectives.zh-CN: 使用电池启动村庄内的音响

objectives.en: Sound any bus horn by the Checkpoint
objectives.zh-CN: 鸣响检查站旁的任意巴士喇叭

description.en: A matter remains at Pendola Pass which should have been settled by our own hands. That path is no longer open to us, so we must ask another.
description.zh-CN: 彭多拉山口还有件事，本该由我们自己解决。但那条路我们已经走不通了，只能求助别人。

objectives.en: Find the Nomad Camp under the Railyard
objectives.zh-CN: 找到铁路站场下方的游民营地

objectives.en: Search for the polluted item in the Nomad camp
objectives.zh-CN: 在游民营地中搜寻被污染的物品

objectives.en: Bring the Equatiorial Sundial to the top of the Church in Old Town
objectives.zh-CN: 将赤道日晷带到老城区教堂的顶端

objectives.en: Deliver the Equatorial Sundial to the Nomadic Envoy
objectives.zh-CN: 将赤道日冕交付给游牧使团

description.en:
A swarm of disoriented Wasps crashed near one of our skylights.

I need you to help thin ARC's ranks before any more accidents happen, and gather some extra sturdy materials to fix the damage.
description.zh-CN:
有群迷路的“黄蜂”撞进了我们的一处天窗。

你得帮我削减ARC的数量，以免它们引发更多事故，以及收集一些特别坚固的材料来修复天窗的损坏。

objectives.en: Destroy 3 ARC enemies
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁3个ARC敌人

objectives.en: Get 3 ARC Alloy for Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 帮萨尼找到3个ARC合金

description.en: Reports about Stella Montis keep coming in, and it’s unlike anything we’ve seen before. There may be records or relics from the past in there, and if so, I want them.
description.zh-CN: 最近不断收到有关于星辰山的报告，那里跟我们之前见过的任何地方都不一样。里面可能存有过去的记录或遗物，如果有的话，我要。

objectives.en: Search any J Kozma Ventures container
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮任意J Kozma Ventures容器

objectives.en: Deliver the Old World Books to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将旧世界之书交给萨尼

description.en: Many Raiders have learned how to dodge a Comet, but far too few know how to bring them down and get at their inner parts.
description.zh-CN: 不少奇袭者都懂得如何躲避“彗星”，可没几个人知道怎么击落它、拆出内部零件。

objectives.en: Destroy a Comet
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“彗星”

objectives.en: Deliver a Comet Igniter to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将“彗星”点火器交给天玟

description.en:
With those Bombardiers roaming around, ARC has found an entirely new way to flush Raiders out of cover. 

If you’re hoping to take one down, you’ll need to sharpen your skills and your strategy.
description.zh-CN:
“投弹手”开始四处游荡，ARC显然找到了一种全新的方法将奇袭者从掩体中逼出来。

如果想要击落“投弹手”，就需要提升你的技巧和策略。

objectives.en: Scope out a cover spot in the Parking Garage staircases
objectives.zh-CN: 探查停车场楼梯间的一个掩护点

objectives.en: Scope out a cover spot in the buses near Marano Park
objectives.zh-CN: 探查马拉诺公园附近巴士中的掩护点

objectives.en: Scope out a cover spot in the attics around Main Street
objectives.zh-CN: 探查主街周围阁楼的一个掩护点

objectives.en: Destroy 2 Spotters
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁2个“侦察员”

objectives.en: Deliver a Spotter Relay to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将一个“侦察员”中继器交给萨尼

description.en: We've been losing signals in some areas of Buried City—my guess is that our equipment is acting up. You’re quite skilled with repairs, aren’t you? Could you check it out?
description.zh-CN: 我们在掩埋废城的某些区域一直丢失信号。可能是我们的设备出问题了。你很擅长修理，对吧？能去检查一下吗？

objectives.en: Reach the Red Tower in Old Town
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达老城区的红塔

objectives.en: Find missing battery cell
objectives.zh-CN: 找到丢失的电池单元

objectives.en: Install the battery cell in the Generator
objectives.zh-CN: 将电池单元安装到发电机中

objectives.en: Enable the power on the Generator
objectives.zh-CN: 启动发电机的电源

objectives.en: Boot the antenna terminal near the Red Tower
objectives.zh-CN: 启动红塔附近的天线终端

description.en: Most explosives end with the detonation. Blaze Grenades have the good sense to keep causing trouble afterward. There may be something worth borrowing in that.
description.zh-CN: 多数爆炸物炸完就没了，但火焰手雷效率更高，炸完还能持续制造麻烦。这思路说不定值得借鉴。

objectives.en: Deal 3000 damage with Blaze Grenades
objectives.zh-CN: 使用火焰手雷造成3000点伤害

label.zh-CN: 使用火焰手雷造成3000点伤害

description.en:
If the data you found can keep the ceiling from collapsing, we have no time to spare.

I know of a few magnetic decryptors around Acerra Spaceport, from back during the Exodus. They might still be working.
description.zh-CN:
如果你找到的数据能防止天花板坍塌，那我们必须立即行动，刻不容缓。

我知道在阿切拉太空港周围有几台“离巢时代”遗留的磁力解密器，可能仍能运作。

objectives.en: Use the Magnetic Decryptor in the Fuel Control Building
objectives.zh-CN: 在燃料控制大楼使用磁力解密器

objectives.en: Reach the Arrival Building in Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达太空港中的到达楼

objectives.en: Use the Magnetic Decryptor on the top floor of the Arrival Building
objectives.zh-CN: 在到达楼顶层使用磁力解密器

description.en: We caught a break. One of our scouts saw a member of the Tubes Management make a dead drop inside the Santa Maria Houses in the Buried City. This might be our chance to dig up some dirt on them for a change. You in?
description.zh-CN: 我们找到突破口了。一名侦察者看到暗道官方管理层的某位成员在掩埋废城的圣玛丽亚住宅区进行了一次秘密投放。这或许是个难得的机会，可以抓住他们的把柄。你参加吗？

objectives.en: Locate the Santa Maria Houses in Old Town
objectives.zh-CN: 到老城区找到圣玛丽亚住宅区

objectives.en: Locate the Dead Drop inside the courtyard
objectives.zh-CN: 在庭院内找到秘密投放点

description.en: If we let those Frigates roam freely, they’ll hit Toledo sooner or later. Was there anything you spotted on top that could cause a distraction?
description.zh-CN: 要是任由那些“护卫者”肆意横行，早晚它们会打到托雷多。你在山顶有没有发现什么能引开它们的东西？

objectives.en: Destroy the Power Cores on top of the Frigate
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁“护卫者”顶部的动力核心

objectives.en: Find a way to access the Frigate's cargo
objectives.zh-CN: 设法进入“护卫者”的货舱

objectives.en: Loot the Frigate's cargo
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮“护卫者”的货物

objectives.en: Destroy a Hydra
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“九头蛇”

objectives.en: Destroy 2 Rocketeers
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁2个“火箭手”

objectives.en: Destroy 2 Vaporizers
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁2个“汽化者”

label.en: Destroy an ARC enemy guarding the Frigate
label.zh-CN: 摧毁1个守卫“护卫者”的ARC敌人

description.en: Say, newbie: if you want me to treat you, you better prove that those precious limbs of yours are worth bandaging.
description.zh-CN: 新来的，规矩是这样的：如果想让我替你治疗，最好证明一下你那宝贵的四肢值得我包扎。

objectives.en: Obtain 1 Syringe
objectives.zh-CN: 获得1支注射器

objectives.en: Obtain 2 Antiseptic
objectives.zh-CN: 获得2份防腐剂

objectives.en: Obtain 1 Durable Cloth
objectives.zh-CN: 获得1块耐磨布料

objectives.en: Obtain 1 Great Mullein
objectives.zh-CN: 获得1个大毛蕊花

objectives.en: Heal any Raider
objectives.zh-CN: 治疗任意奇袭者

description.en:
During the First Wave, the Barons did more damage than all the other machines combined. Now they’re mere husks; fixed in place where they once fell... 

Still, their internals might hold the answer to keeping ARC at bay. So open one up, and bring me whatever is inside.
description.zh-CN: 在“第一波”攻击中，“男爵”比其他所有机器加起来都更具破坏力。如今它们已经成了无用的空壳，倒在那里后就再没有被挪动过……不过，它们内部可能藏着抵御ARC的解决方案。去找一个撬开，把里面的东西带给我。

objectives.en: Loot a Baron husk
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮一个“男爵”残骸

description.en:
Raiders have long reported peculiar-looking crates dropping down from malfunctioning ARC Probes. 

If we can figure out a way to crack them open, we might get a better understanding of what it is they’re after.
description.zh-CN: 一直以来有奇袭者报告说，出故障的ARC探测器会空投外表奇特的箱子。如果能撬开这种箱子，或许能摸清它们的目的。

objectives.en: Visit a Field Depot
objectives.zh-CN: 访问1个前线仓库

objectives.en: Deliver a Field Crate to a Field Depot
objectives.zh-CN: 将箱子交付至前线仓库

objectives.en: Collect the reward
objectives.zh-CN: 领取奖励

description.en: I sent a scout team to the Spaceport a while ago. Routine work — cataloging security, see if there's anything we could re-purpose. But I've heard nothing for two days.
description.zh-CN: 不久前我派了一支侦察队去太空港，执行常规任务，就是登记安保设施，看看有无可再利用的设备。但已经两天没有收到他们的消息了。

objectives.en: Visit any Field Depot on the eastern side of the Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 访问太空港东侧的任意前线仓库

objectives.en: Use the Field Radio to transmit the scout group’s last log to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 使用野外电台将侦察队的最后日志发送给萨尼

objectives.en: Interact with the terminal in the old Raider Tower north of the Maintenance Hangar
objectives.zh-CN: 与维修区机库北侧旧奇袭者塔楼中的终端互动

objectives.en: Find traces of the scout patrol near the Maintenance Hangar
objectives.zh-CN: 在维修区机库附近寻找侦察队的踪迹

objectives.en: Search the remains left by the scouts
objectives.zh-CN: 搜查侦察员留下的遗物

objectives.en: Deliver the Scout Patrol Note to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将侦察巡逻报告交给萨尼

description.en: Did you feel any tremors last night? Me neither. But apparently the ground shifted at some point, and in the process it unearthed an old First Wave outpost that’d been blocked by debris. I’d like you to get in there quick, before anyone else does.
description.zh-CN: 你昨晚感觉到有震动吗？我也没有。但显然地面在某个时间点被移动了，在这个过程中，一个被废墟阻塞的旧“第一波”哨站暴露了出来。我想让你尽快进去探查一下，以防被别人捷足先登。

objectives.en: Reach Victory Ridge
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达凯旋岭

objectives.en: Retrieve the battle plans from the hideout under the broken highway
objectives.zh-CN: 从断裂高速公路下的藏身处取回作战计划

objectives.en: Deliver Major Aiva's Patch to Celeste
objectives.zh-CN: 将艾娃少校的臂章交给塞莱斯特

description.en: Armor does a good job against bullets. Small explosions are less respectful of the arrangement. Combining the two might be worth exploring.
description.zh-CN: 护甲能有效抵挡子弹，但小型爆炸就没那么好防了。如何把两者结合起来，或许值得研究。

objectives.en: Deal 1000 Damage to Fireflies using Light Impact Grenades
objectives.zh-CN: 使用轻型冲击手雷对“萤火虫”造成1000点伤害

objectives.en: Deal 1000 Damage to Hornets using Light Impact Grenades
objectives.zh-CN: 使用轻型冲击手雷对“马蜂”造成1000点伤害

objectives.en: Deal 1000 Damage to Fireballs using Light Impact Grenades
objectives.zh-CN: 使用轻型冲击手雷对“火球”造成1000点伤害

objectives.en: Deal 1000 Damage to Surveyors using Light Impact Grenades
objectives.zh-CN: 使用轻型冲击手雷对“勘测师”造成1000点伤害

description.en: To think I may have kin just dangling in a shipment crate… What horror! What unspeakable horror!
description.zh-CN: 想到我的亲人可能就吊在货运箱里……太可怕了！简直骇人听闻！

objectives.en: Reach the Trench Towers in the Spaceport Trench
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达太空港壕沟的壕沟塔

objectives.en: Find the Terminal and disable the Magnetic Lock
objectives.zh-CN: 找到终端并解除磁锁

objectives.en: Find the Magnetic Lock on the Crate and manually disable it
objectives.zh-CN: 找到货运箱上的磁锁并手动解除它

objectives.en: Search the Cargo Crate
objectives.zh-CN: 搜查货运箱

objectives.en: Deliver the Project Pathos Empathy Core to Lance
objectives.zh-CN: 将“悲怆计划”共情核心交付给兰斯

label.en: Disable the Magnetic Lock holding the Cargo Crate
label.zh-CN: 解除固定货运箱的磁锁

description.en: A Raider came into my shop earlier, to trade some grenades for a machine she found in Buried City. She said it makes coffee, but it seems to be missing a few parts. Up for a job?
description.zh-CN: 早些时候，一个奇袭者来到我店里，想用她在掩埋废城找到的一台机器换一些手雷。她说那台机器能做咖啡，但好像缺了一些零件。想接这个任务吗？

objectives.en: Find an espresso machine to salvage for spare parts
objectives.zh-CN: 找到一台浓缩咖啡机，拆取可用零件

objectives.en: Get the Espresso Machine Parts for Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 为阿波罗找到浓缩咖啡机零件

description.en: ARC’s always been drawn to gunfire and commotion, but we’ve never seen them quite converge on a place like they have at Pendola Pass.
description.zh-CN: ARC向来会被枪声和骚动吸引，但我们从没见过它们像在彭多拉山口这样，大规模聚集。

objectives.en: Destroy 20 ARC enemies
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁20个ARC敌人

objectives.en: Search the control room at the Cielo Sereno Observatory for power
objectives.zh-CN: 检查晴空天文台控制室的供电情况

objectives.en: Use 1 Wire to patch into the antenna on top of the tallest tower in the Railyard
objectives.zh-CN: 使用1根导线接入铁路站场最高塔顶的天线

objectives.en: Search 3 containers inside the Commissary Supermarket
objectives.zh-CN: 在军需超市内搜查3个容器

description.en: A burst has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The middle could probably use more bullets. Let's investigate.
description.zh-CN: 连发有起势、中段和收尾。中段的子弹可以再加多点，咱们研究一下。

objectives.en: Deal 10000 damage with a Burst Burletta or Charged Burst Aphelion
objectives.zh-CN: 使用连发型“喜歌剧”或蓄力连发型“远日点”造成10000点伤害

label.en: Deal 10000 damage with a Burst Burletta or Charged Burst Aphelion
label.zh-CN: 使用连发型“喜歌剧”或蓄力连发型“远日点”造成10000点伤害

description.en: Those LiDAR scanners you found work best when put in high locations. I’ve identified a few good spots around the Rust Belt; hope you’re surefooted.
description.zh-CN: 你找到的激光雷达扫描仪放在高处效果最好。我在锈带标了几个好位置，但愿你不会恐高。

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, install a LiDAR Scanner at the top of the Control Tower
objectives.zh-CN: 前往大坝战场，将激光雷达扫描仪安装到控制塔顶部

objectives.en: On Spaceport, install a LiDAR Scanner at the Communications Tower
objectives.zh-CN: 前往太空港，将激光雷达扫描仪安装到通讯塔上

objectives.en: On Buried City, install a LiDAR Scanner on top of the Galleria sign
objectives.zh-CN: 前往掩埋废城，将激光雷达扫描仪安装到画廊招牌顶部

description.en: Everything’s been calm around my drop-offs since you helped out, but that doesn’t mean it’ll stay that way for long. I’ve set up surveillance at one of my most used spots in Buried City, to prevent future tampering. Only problem is, it needs power to go live.
description.zh-CN: 自从你出手相助之后，我的投放点周围一直很平静，但这种情况估计不会持续太久。我在掩埋废城最常用的一个点设置了监控，以防止未来有人打它的歪主意。唯一的问题是，它需要电力才能启动。

objectives.en: Find the secluded roof terrace south-west of the Southern Station, look for blue tarps.
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找位于南侧地铁站西南边的隐蔽屋顶露台，并在那找到蓝色防水布。

objectives.en: Rewire the solar panel using 3 Wires
objectives.zh-CN: 使用3根电线给太阳能面板重新接线

description.en: My usual engineer is still healing from his wounds, and has been loopy for days. We can’t afford to be at half-grid until he heals; I need someone to pick up his wrench in the mean time.
description.zh-CN: 我平时用的工程师还在养伤，已经神志不清好几天了。在他痊愈之前，这里总不能处于半瘫痪状态，需要有人在这段时间接手他的工作。

objectives.en: Find the Generator Room
objectives.zh-CN: 找到发电机房

objectives.en: Repair the Generator using 4 Wires
objectives.zh-CN: 使用4根电线修理发电机

objectives.en: Find the Ventilation Shaft
objectives.zh-CN: 找到通风井

objectives.en: Enable the power via the power switch underneath the stairs
objectives.zh-CN: 用楼梯下方的电源开关启动电源

description.en: Now that we’ve found our footing on Stella Montis, several parties are interested in digging a bit deeper and seeing what we can find out about the past of this place. To do so, however, we’ll need to power up some of these old machines so we can start to sift through the data.
description.zh-CN: 我们在星辰山站稳脚跟后，多方势力都想深入挖掘此地的过往。但要做到这一点，我们得给这些老旧机械供电，才能梳理数据。

objectives.en: In either of the Robotic Sandbox control rooms, repair the out-of-service terminal with 1 Electrical Component
objectives.zh-CN: 在机器人沙盘的任意控制室，使用1个电子元件修复故障终端

objectives.en: Enable the power in any of the conduit backrooms near the Robotic Sandboxes
objectives.zh-CN: 接通机器人沙盘附近的任意管道后勤室的电源

objectives.en: Boot the main frame data terminal in the Cultural Archives service backrooms
objectives.zh-CN: 启动文化档案馆后勤室的主机数据终端

description.en: I’m still sorting through the data you found in Stella Montis, but something’s caught my eye. I’d like you to look into it.
description.zh-CN: 我还在整理你在星辰山找到的数据，但有件事引起了我的注意，我想让你去调查下。

objectives.en: Search for the secret meeting spot under a staircase in the Medical Research Area
objectives.zh-CN: 在医学研究部区域的一处楼梯下方搜寻秘密集会地点

objectives.en: Find the secret meeting spot near the ventilation shaft between Robotic Sandbox B and Seed Vault
objectives.zh-CN: 在机器人沙盘B区和种子库之间的通风井附近找到秘密集会地点

objectives.en: Find the secret meeting spot at the bottom of the staircase connecting the Cultural Archives and Seed Vault
objectives.zh-CN: 在连接文化档案馆和种子库的楼梯底部找到秘密集会地点

objectives.en: Search the meeting area
objectives.zh-CN: 搜查集会区域

objectives.en: Bring the Secret Meeting Info to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将秘密集会情报交给萨尼

description.en:
Recently, I’ve been trying and failing to get Tian Wen to join our community projects.

I may have to sweeten the deal. She’s been complaining about the quality of salvage found on the market; think we could do her a solid?
description.zh-CN: 最近我一直想拉天玟加入我们的社区项目，但没成功。我可能得让她先得点甜头了。她一直吐槽市场上回收物品的质量。能不能以此为切入点，帮她个忙？

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, visit the Locked Room in the Water Treatment Control building
objectives.zh-CN: 在大坝战场，前往水处理控制大楼的上锁房间

objectives.en: On Spaceport, scope out the rocket thrusters outside the Rocket Assembly
objectives.zh-CN: 在太空港，侦察火箭组装区外的火箭推进器

objectives.en: On Buried City, visit the barricaded area on floor 6 of the Space Travel Building
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城，前往航天大楼6层的封锁区域

objectives.en: Find a spare Dam Surveillance Key
objectives.zh-CN: 找到备用的大坝监控室钥匙

description.en: Data or no data: we’ll learn how to make this place earthquake-proof. With a research this in-depth, there’s bound to be a paper trail somewhere.
description.zh-CN: 无论有没有数据：我们将学会如何让这个地方抗震。如此深入的研究，必定会留下书面记录。

objectives.en: Find a spare Blue Gate Communication Tower Key
objectives.zh-CN: 找到备用的蓝门通讯塔钥匙

objectives.en: Enter the locked room at Pilgrim's Peak
objectives.zh-CN: 进入朝圣峰的上锁房间

objectives.en: Search the room for any construction research
objectives.zh-CN: 在房间内搜寻建筑研究资料

objectives.en: Find the building pictured on the whiteboard
objectives.zh-CN: 找到白板上描绘的建筑

objectives.en: Photograph the abandoned housing project
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄废弃的住宅工程

description.en: Our scouts have reported several Raider Hatches with leaking hydraulic pipes. They still work, but not for long. Mind patching one up, next time you’re out there?
description.zh-CN: 我们的侦察者报告说，有几个奇袭者暗门的液压管漏水了。虽然还能用，但撑不了多久。下次外出的时候，能不能去补好其中一个？

objectives.en: Repair the leaking hydraulic pipes near a Raider Hatch
objectives.zh-CN: 修理奇袭者暗门附近泄漏的液压管

objectives.en: Search for a Hatch Key near the Raider Hatch
objectives.zh-CN: 在奇袭者暗门附近寻找暗门钥匙

description.en: Some ARC machines appear capable of absorbing energy before putting it back to use. The same principle might be worth testing on something a little less insulated.
description.zh-CN: 部分ARC机器似乎能吸收能量再加以利用。同样的原理，或许可以在绝缘性没那么好的东西上试试。

objectives.en: Destroy 5 ARC Turbines
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁5个ARC“涡轮”

label.zh-CN: 高压暴露试验

description.en: All of these old logs mention mutinies being repressed by MANTIKOR… Then suddenly, nothing. The entries just stop, a few weeks before the Exodus.
description.zh-CN: 这些旧日志都提到螫蝎镇压了多起叛乱……然后突然就中断了。就在“离巢”计划前几周，日志戛然而止。

objectives.en: Reach the back of the Blue Gate tunnels
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达蓝门隧道深处

objectives.en: Scan any Android in the back of the Traffic Tunnels
objectives.zh-CN: 扫描通行隧道深处的任意机器人

objectives.en: Head to the MANTIKOR locker room
objectives.zh-CN: 前往螫蝎更衣室

objectives.en: Search the locker room for any clues
objectives.zh-CN: 在更衣室中搜寻线索

objectives.en: Read the last vehicle weighing logs
objectives.zh-CN: 查阅最新的车辆称重记录

objectives.en: Find the hidden key
objectives.zh-CN: 找到隐藏钥匙

objectives.en: Enter the Confiscation Room
objectives.zh-CN: 进入没收物库房

objectives.en: Transmit MANTIKOR’s security last recordings to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将螫蝎的最新安保录音传输给萨尼

description.en: I just treated one of the first Raiders who visited Stella Montis, and she said that she saw... others. Androids, very much like me.
description.zh-CN: 我刚治疗了一位首批进入星辰山的奇袭者，她说她看到了其他的……人形机器人，非常像我的那种。

objectives.en: Deploy into Stella Montis
objectives.zh-CN: 部署到星辰山

objectives.en: Find and search 3 Androids
objectives.zh-CN: 找到并搜索3个人形机器人

description.en: With my own stashes secured, I think it might be time to keep a closer eye on the competition so this doesn’t happen again.
description.zh-CN: 既然我自己的藏货安全了，也许是时候更密切地监视竞争对手，以免这种事再次发生。

objectives.en: Find Tian Wen's weapon cache near the Gas Station in the Outskirts
objectives.zh-CN: 在郊区的加油站附近找到天玟的武器储物箱

objectives.en: Deliver the Burletta to the rival weapon cache
objectives.zh-CN: 将“喜歌剧”送至对手的武器储物箱

objectives.en: Plant a bug on the weapon cache
objectives.zh-CN: 在武器箱上安装窃听器

description.en:
It used to be their world, up there. Nobody to challenge their claim. 

Yet here we are. More outposts. More intel. More firepower. If I didn’t know better, I’d say we’ve got quite a bit of fight left in us.
description.zh-CN: 上面曾经是它们的地盘，无人能撼动其霸权。可如今呢？哨站越建越多，情报网越铺越广，火力装备越来越强。要是不知情，我甚至会说——我们这帮人，骨子里的血性可半点没少。

objectives.en: Destroy a Leaper
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“跳跃者”

objectives.en: Destroy 4 Leaper legs
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁4个“跳跃者”腿部

objectives.en: Obtain a Leaper Pulse Unit
objectives.zh-CN: 获得一个“跳跃者”脉冲单元

description.en:
I’m looking for someone. Bilguun. You might’ve seen him around, but chances are you haven’t. He’s… not the most sociable person around, you see.

He spends a lot of time Topside, but usually returns to Speranza regularly to check in.
description.zh-CN:
我在找一个名叫比尔根的人。你可能见过他，但多半没有。他这人……不怎么爱交际。

大部分时间都在上层，但通常会定期返回斯佩兰扎露个脸。

objectives.en: Locate the collapsed highway by the southern edge of the Barren Clearing
objectives.zh-CN: 在荒芜空地南部边缘找到坍塌的高速公路

objectives.en: Find Bilguun's shelter, and search for any clues of his presence
objectives.zh-CN: 找到比尔根的庇护所，并搜寻有关他下落的线索

description.en: I lost my cool a bit when I sent you after that trap. I don’t usually lose my temper, but the First Wave… We went through a lot, back then. Lost a lot of people. It’s still a bit of a raw wound for me, but I want you to understand.
description.zh-CN: 当初派你去处理那个陷阱时，我有点失控了。我一般不轻易发火，但“第一波”……我们那时经历了很多苦难，失去了很多人。我至今还没有走出来，但我想让你理解它的意义。

objectives.en: Reach the wreckage in the Formicai Hills
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达蚁丘山的残骸处

objectives.en: Search for the missing helmet
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找丢失的头盔

objectives.en: Return the helmet to the memorial
objectives.zh-CN: 把头盔带回纪念碑

description.en: More mentions of MANTIKOR, and more clear signs of dissent among the researchers. I suspect tensions eventually escalated.
description.zh-CN: 文件中多次提及螫蝎，研究员之间的分歧也愈发明显。我怀疑矛盾最终激化了。

objectives.en: Find and access the right work station in the Seed Vault for clues
objectives.zh-CN: 在种子库中找到并使用正确的工作站获取线索

objectives.en: Search for the hidden key in the adjacent room
objectives.zh-CN: 在相邻房间搜寻隐藏钥匙

objectives.en: Search the Seed Vault and unlock the seed deposit box
objectives.zh-CN: 搜索种子库并解锁种子存放箱

objectives.en: Search the seed deposit box
objectives.zh-CN: 搜索种子存放箱

objectives.en: Bring the Official Shutdown Documentation to Shani
objectives.zh-CN: 将官方关停文件交给萨尼

description.en: This place could use a makeover, but I don’t want it looking like your raggedy Raider Dens. See if you can find out how my fellow medical greats used to live.
description.zh-CN: 这地方需要翻修一下，但我不想把它弄得跟你们那破破烂烂的奇袭者巢穴一样。你去了解一下我那些杰出的医疗同行以前的生活是怎样的。

objectives.en: Find the Arbusto Farmacia by the collapsed highway
objectives.zh-CN: 在崩塌高速公路旁找到阿布斯托药房

objectives.en: Document the pharmacist’s skills
objectives.zh-CN: 记录药剂师的技能

objectives.en: Document the pharmacist’s taste
objectives.zh-CN: 记录药剂师的品味

objectives.en: Document the pharmacist’s family
objectives.zh-CN: 记录药剂师的家人

objectives.en: Document the pharmacist’s hobbies
objectives.zh-CN: 记录药剂师的爱好

description.en: That Stella Montis hard drive contained more than just the shutdown documentation - it also had the transport schedules of some pretty critical Exodus components.
description.zh-CN: 那个星辰山硬盘里不光有关停文件，还有“离巢”关键部件的运输时刻表。

objectives.en: Find out why the train never reached Marano Station
objectives.zh-CN: 查明列车为何未能抵达马拉诺车站

objectives.en: Find out who orchestrated the robbery
objectives.zh-CN: 查明策划劫案的主谋

objectives.en: Find out where the thruster valves were stashed
objectives.zh-CN: 查明推进器阀门的藏匿地点

objectives.en: Search the basement of the merchant’s nearby apartment
objectives.zh-CN: 搜查附近商人公寓的地下室

description.en: I have equipment set up at the Spaceport, to monitor ARC’s movements. My connection broke down just now — I need you to head to the Control Towers and help me retrieve my logs.
description.zh-CN: 我在太空港安装了一套设备，用于监测ARC的动向。刚才连接中断了——你去趟控制塔，帮我取回日志。

objectives.en: Visit Control Tower A6
objectives.zh-CN: 前往控制塔A6

objectives.en: Find a spare key
objectives.zh-CN: 找到一把备用钥匙

objectives.en: Reach the top of Control Tower A6
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达控制塔A6顶部

objectives.en: Establish a connection from the terminal
objectives.zh-CN: 通过终端建立连接

description.en: A standard magazine does its job, but it can only hold so much. Getting familiar with a drum-fed design could reveal how that extra room is put to use, and where the same idea might fit elsewhere.
description.zh-CN: 标准弹匣够用，但容量毕竟有限。研究弹鼓供弹设计，既能弄清扩容的原理，也能看看这套思路还能用在什么地方。

objectives.en: Deal 15000 damage to a Bastion with a Rattler
objectives.zh-CN: 使用“响尾蛇”对“堡垒”造成15000点伤害

objectives.en: Destroy 1 Bastions with a Rattler
objectives.zh-CN: 使用“响尾蛇”摧毁1个“堡垒”

label.zh-CN: 弹匣结构入门

description.en: Someone has been lifting supplies from my drop-off point in Buried City. I’ve set up a trap, but I need someone to check it for me.
description.zh-CN: 有人一直从我在掩埋废城的投放点偷取物资。我设了一个陷阱，但需要有人去帮我检查一下触发情况。

objectives.en: Reach the Su Durante Warehouses in the Outskirts in Buried City
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达掩埋废城郊区的苏杜兰仓库

objectives.en: Search for Tian Wen's cache near the Warehouses
objectives.zh-CN: 在仓库附近搜索天玟的储物箱

objectives.en: Follow the clues
objectives.zh-CN: 追踪线索

description.en: That theft before? Doesn’t look like a coincidence anymore. Some of the competition from Toledo is setting up shop where they don’t belong. I want their cache sabotaged, preferably before they get too comfortable.
description.zh-CN: 之前那次失窃事件，现在看来不像是巧合。我们来自托雷多的竞争对手正在不属于他们的地方建立据点。我想破坏他们的储物箱——最好在他们站稳脚跟之前。

objectives.en: Locate the cache near Marano Station
objectives.zh-CN: 找到马拉诺车站附近的储物箱

objectives.en: Sabotage the cache
objectives.zh-CN: 破坏储物箱

description.en: I’ve become quite crafty at weaving bandages from Fabric, but to my shame, I haven’t quite mastered weaving an x-ray machine or a pulse oximiter.
description.zh-CN: 我用布料编织绷带是一把好手……但X光机和血氧仪我可整不出来。

objectives.en: On Spaceport, search 2 containers in the Departure Building's exam rooms
objectives.zh-CN: 在太空港候机楼的体检室中搜索2个容器

objectives.en: Search 3 containers in the Hospital in Buried City
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城的医院搜索3个容器

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, search 2 containers in the Research & Administration building's medical room
objectives.zh-CN: 在大坝战场的研究与行政区大楼的医疗室搜索2个容器

description.en:
Have you spotted any Surveyors; the big round ones? 

They seem to be transmitting data back into orbit, and I can’t help but think it's tied to that signal we picked up. Will you break one open, so we can try to decipher the data?
description.zh-CN: 你看到过“勘测师”吗，就是像大圆球一样的？它们似乎在向轨道传输数据，我在想这可能跟我们捕捉到的信号有关。你看能不能破拆“勘测师”，这样我们就能尝试解密数据了。

objectives.en: Destroy an ARC Surveyor
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一架ARC“勘测师”

objectives.en: Obtain 1 Surveyor Vault
objectives.zh-CN: 获得1个“勘测师”保险库

description.en: Everyone's been on edge ever since rumors of that ARC signal spread. I was thinking a movie night would be a great distraction, but I'm missing some crucial supplies. You'll help me out, yeah?
description.zh-CN: 自从那个ARC信号的传言传开，大伙儿都一直坐立不安。我一直想搞个电影之夜活动，让大家放松一下神经。但我的投影机缺了一些关键物资。你能帮我找一下吗？

objectives.en: Deliver a Portable TV to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将一台便携电视交给阿波罗

objectives.en: On Stella Montis, search the Cultural Archives for old movie tapes
objectives.zh-CN: 在星辰山文化档案馆中寻找旧电影录像带

objectives.en: Deliver the Stack of Movie Tapes to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将一堆电影录像带交给阿波罗

description.en: Heard you’re looking to pick a fight with the big girls. Bring your best gear, but don’t think that alone will cut it.
description.zh-CN: 听说你想找那些“大女主们”干一架。带上你最好的装备，但别以为光靠装备就够了。

objectives.en: Destroy a Matriarch
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“族母”

objectives.en: Destroy a Queen
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁1个“女王”

objectives.en: Deliver a Queen Reactor to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将1个“女王”反应堆交付给阿波罗

objectives.en: Deliver a Matriarch Reactor to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将1个“族母”反应堆交付给阿波罗

description.en: There was a time I’d tell you tell stay well away from Queens and Matriarchs, but these days… I wish we still had that luxury.
description.zh-CN: 换作以前，我肯定劝你离“女王”和“族母”远远的，但现在……真希望我们还有这份从容选择的余地。

objectives.en: Destroy 3 Comets
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁3个“彗星”

objectives.en: Destroy 5 Rocketeers
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁5个“火箭手”

objectives.en: Destroy 2 Sentinels
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁2个“哨卫”

objectives.en: Deliver 3 Comet Igniters to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将3个“彗星”点火器交付给阿波罗

objectives.en: Deliver 3 Rocketeer Drivers to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将3个“火箭手”引擎交付给阿波罗

objectives.en: Deliver 6 ARC Circuitry to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将6个ARC线圈交付给阿波罗

objectives.en: Deliver 6 ARC Motion Cores to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将6个ARC运动核心交付给阿波罗

objectives.en: Destroy a Bombardier on Buried City
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城摧毁1个“投弹手”

objectives.en: Destroy a Bastion on Stella Montis
objectives.zh-CN: 在星辰山摧毁1个“堡垒”

description.en: The damage down here was pretty bad, but our Topside infrastructure was hit even harder. I still have several antennas that stopped working after the storm.
description.zh-CN: 下面虽然也一片狼藉，但我们的上层基础设施的情况更不乐观，好几座天线在风暴后就瘫痪了。

objectives.en: Visit a Field Depot
objectives.zh-CN: 访问1个前线仓库

objectives.en: Repair the antenna on the roof of the Field Depot
objectives.zh-CN: 修理前线仓库屋顶的天线

description.en:
Seems like every other Raider here has some serious hearing damage.

I heard rumors they developed some extra advanced hearing aids at Stella Montis. If you can track them down, we might all be able to use our indoor voices, for once.
description.zh-CN:
这里的奇袭者似乎个个听力都有严重损伤。

我听说星辰山那边研发了一些超先进的助听器。如果能找到，我们就能用正常音量说话了。

objectives.en: Find the researcher's guest logs on the reception computers
objectives.zh-CN: 在接待处电脑上查找研究员的访客记录

objectives.en: Find where the researcher held their lecture, and access their notes
objectives.zh-CN: 找到研究员举办讲座的地点，并查阅她的笔记

objectives.en: Find information about the prototypes on the Medical Research computers
objectives.zh-CN: 在医学研究部电脑上查找原型的信息

objectives.en: Find the printed shipping logs in the Assembly Workshops
objectives.zh-CN: 在组装厂车间里找到打印的货运日志

description.en: We know the coordinates for those hearing aids, but I’ll have to cross-reference them with a paper map of the Spaceport. Those legs of yours aren’t too tired, are they?
description.zh-CN: 我们知道那些助听器的坐标，但我得拿它跟太空港的纸质地图核对一下。你应该还没累到挪不动腿吧？

objectives.en: Head to where the Fuel Lines snapped, and transmit your location
objectives.zh-CN: 前往燃料管道断裂处，并发送你的位置

objectives.en: Head to the antenna near the Fuel Control, and transmit your location
objectives.zh-CN: 前往燃料控制单元附近的天线处，并发送你的位置

objectives.en: Head to the cactus patch in the wall breach, and transmit your location
objectives.zh-CN: 前往墙壁缺口处的仙人掌丛，并发送你的位置

objectives.en: Transmit your location from the roof of the Container Storage building
objectives.zh-CN: 从集装箱仓库大楼屋顶发送你的位置

objectives.en: Find the container covered in tarp, and mark it
objectives.zh-CN: 找到盖有防水布的容器，并标记它

description.en: ARC may be changing, but we’re finally changing with it. Let’s finish up those outposts and revolutionize the way we track them, flank them, and smash them to bits.
description.zh-CN: ARC一直在改变，现在我们终于也可以与时俱进了。我们来把那些哨站建完，之后就能彻底改变追踪、包抄以及有效摧毁它们的方式。

objectives.en: Visit the Pattern House in The Dam
objectives.zh-CN: 前往大坝中的壁画屋

objectives.en: Find and flip the power switch
objectives.zh-CN: 找到并扳动电源开关

objectives.en: Complete the antenna installation on the roof
objectives.zh-CN: 完成屋顶上的天线安装

description.en: Did you see the flags? The time for cowering is over. You’ve been more than battle-tested, from what I hear; think you can take on a Rocketeer?
description.zh-CN: 你看到那些旗帜了吗？躲躲闪闪的日子已经结束。我听说你身经百战了，你觉得自己能对付“火箭手”吗？

objectives.en: Destroy a Rocketeer
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“火箭手”

objectives.en: Obtain a Rocketeer Driver
objectives.zh-CN: 获得一个“火箭手”引擎

description.en:
I had a deal for a Bastion Cell lined up with a Raider called Dodger, but he's gone quiet. 

I need someone to track down his stash before some scavenger stumbles into it. Interested?
description.zh-CN:
我和一个叫道奇的奇袭者约好交易一个“堡垒”电池，可他突然失联了。

我需要有人帮忙追回他的储备箱，避免落入拾荒者之手。有兴趣吗？

objectives.en: Search for Dodger's stash inside the Traffic Tunnel
objectives.zh-CN: 在通行隧道内寻找道奇的储备箱

objectives.en: Search Dodger's deal spot by the Pilgrim's Peak antenna
objectives.zh-CN: 搜查朝圣峰天线附近道奇的交易地点

objectives.en: Deliver Dodger's Note to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将道奇的笔记交给天玟

description.en: For an entire sector to collapse like that… No wonder people are scared. We need to reinforce beyond anything we’ve done before, and we can’t do it alone.
description.zh-CN: 整片区域就这样坍塌……难怪大家这么害怕。我们必须进行前所未有的加固工程，但单靠我们不行。

objectives.en: Go to any ENELICA building
objectives.zh-CN: 前往任意艾纳里卡建筑

objectives.en: Search for a notice board with a note from the researcher
objectives.zh-CN: 搜寻写有研究员笔记的公告板

objectives.en: On Buried City, reach the top floor above the Convinio in Piazza Roma
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城，抵达罗马广场中康维尼奥上方的顶层

objectives.en: Find the researcher's flat and search for any research data
objectives.zh-CN: 找到研究员的公寓并搜寻研究数据

description.en: The storm has mostly settled, but much of our infrastructure has taken a proper beating. If you're hoping to stay with us, I'll need you to pull your weight in the repair efforts.
description.zh-CN: 风暴已经基本平息，但我们的设施损毁严重。如果你想继续待在这里，就必须为修复工作出一份力。

objectives.en: Visit any area on your map with a loot category icon
objectives.zh-CN: 访问你地图上带有搜刮类别图标的区域

objectives.en: Loot 3 containers
objectives.zh-CN: 搜刮3个容器

description.en: This goes beyond bad luck. Something—or someone—has knocked out some of our electrical substations. The engineer I sent out to fix it hasn’t returned, so I need all available Raiders to look into it. That includes you.
description.zh-CN: 这不仅仅是倒霉了。某些东西或者某些人，摧毁了我们的部分变电站。我派去修理的工程师没有回来，所以我不得不调派所有能用的奇袭者去调查这件事。包括你。

objectives.en: Find the Electrical Substation south of the Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 到太空港南部找到变电站

objectives.en: Find any sign of the missing engineer
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找失联工程师的踪迹

objectives.en: Install the fuse
objectives.zh-CN: 安装保险丝

objectives.en: Restore the power
objectives.zh-CN: 恢复电力

description.en: I’ve been curious about the medical area in the Spaceport for a while now. Something tells me it’s got just what I need to become the undeniable champion of this place.
description.zh-CN: 我一直对太空港的医疗区域很好奇。直觉告诉我，这里有能让我成为这座城区绝对王者的契机。

objectives.en: Visit the Departure Building in Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 前往太空港中的候机楼

objectives.en: Find the Medical Exam Room inside the Departure Building
objectives.zh-CN: 找到候机楼里的体检室

objectives.en: Search for the records
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找医疗记录

description.en: That collapsed highway worries me; it looks to be recent. Much of Topside may be in ruins, but most of it is from ages ago.
description.zh-CN: 那段坍塌的高速让我有点担心。看起来是最近才发生的事。上层大部分地区可能已经变成废墟，但大多是很久以前的事了。

objectives.en: Take a photo of the Collapsed Highway
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄崩塌高速公路的照片

objectives.en: Go to the Broken Earth
objectives.zh-CN: 前往破碎地貌

objectives.en: Follow the trail of destruction through the Broken Earth
objectives.zh-CN: 沿着破碎地貌中的毁灭之迹调查

objectives.en: Investigate the unknown ARC machines
objectives.zh-CN: 调查未知的ARC机器

description.en: That Emperor didn’t just trip and fall… It was brought down. And I have a leading theory about how that happened.
description.zh-CN: 那台“帝王”机器不是自己摔的……是被击毁的。至于怎么击毁的，我目前有个最靠谱的推测。

objectives.en: Connect a Spotter Relay to the antenna on the roof of the Cielo Sereno Observatory
objectives.zh-CN: 将一个“侦察员”中继器连接到晴空天文台屋顶的天线上

objectives.en: Weld the wires in the crawlspace under the control room to redirect power
objectives.zh-CN: 焊接控制室下方爬行通道内的线路以改接电力

objectives.en: Activate the Spotter Relay at the antenna again
objectives.zh-CN: 再次启动天线处的“侦察员”中继器

description.en: Seems like news of the train derailment spread fast… And drove many workers to stash some very tasty technology away from prying eyes.
description.zh-CN: 列车脱轨的消息传得真快……还促使不少工人把值钱的科技装备藏了起来，避开耳目。

objectives.en: Find the clue left by the restaurant kitchen staff
objectives.zh-CN: 找到餐厅后厨员工留下的线索

objectives.en: Find the area portrayed in the sketch
objectives.zh-CN: 找到素描中描绘的区域

objectives.en: Dig up the buried part
objectives.zh-CN: 挖出掩埋的零件

objectives.en: Deliver the Precision Gimbal to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将精密云台交给天玟

description.en:
I heard rumors about some signal Shani picked up. ARC is constantly adapting, and I'm sure this won’t be their last warning sign.

Well, if it’s an arms race they want, they can get one.
description.zh-CN:
我听说萨尼捕捉到一些奇怪的信号。看来ARC在不断适应，这应该不是它们最后的警告信号。

好吧，如果它们想要来一场军备竞赛，那我们就满足它们。

objectives.en: Destroy 2 ARC enemies using any explosive grenade
objectives.zh-CN: 使用任意爆炸式手雷摧毁2个ARC敌人

description.en: Lucky for you, Dodger's debt can still be settled. Bring me a Bastion Cell. A real one, pulled from a real Bastion. Consider what Dodger owed me transferred to credit for you. Okay?
description.zh-CN: 算你走运，道奇的债还能结清。给我弄一个“堡垒”电池，必须是从真正的“堡垒”上拆下来的。道奇欠我的债，就抵作你的报酬，怎么样？

objectives.en: Destroy a Bastion
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“堡垒”

objectives.en: Deliver a Bastion Cell to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将“堡垒”电池交给天玟

description.en: Sustained damage could reveal exactly what makes a shield give out, and how to make that happen faster. For science, naturally.
description.zh-CN: 持续伤害能帮我们摸清护盾失效的原理，以及如何加速这一过程。当然，都是为了科学。

objectives.en: Deal 700 damage to encountered Raiders
objectives.zh-CN: 对遭遇的奇袭者造成700点伤害

label.zh-CN: 护盾应力测试

description.en:
The wide-open coastline used to mean danger, but now it's the only place we can spot new threats moving into the Rust Belt.

So we'll have to make our own cover, and reinforce what few defenses we can find.
description.zh-CN:
过去，开阔的海岸线曾是危险的象征；但现在，这里是我们唯一能发现威胁侵入锈带的地方。

所以我们得自己搭建掩体，加固仅存的防御工事。

objectives.en: Destroy 5 Wasps
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁5个“黄蜂”

objectives.en: Destroy 3 Fireflies
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁3个“萤火虫”

objectives.en: Use 1 ARC Alloy to reinforce the Raider structure on top of any Stacking Yard crane
objectives.zh-CN: 使用1块ARC合金，加固任意堆料场起重机顶部的奇袭者建筑

objectives.en: Board up shuttered windows in the hotel
objectives.zh-CN: 用木板封住酒店的百叶窗

description.en: Those Emperors were imposing enough from a distance, but to be able to get so up close… If there was ever a time to tread carefully, this would be it.
description.zh-CN: 那些“帝王”机器远远看着就够有压迫感了，现在居然能靠这么近……这个时候，最适合采取步步为营的策略了。

objectives.en: Take a photo of the Emperor's leg by the bridge outside Old Town
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄老城区外大桥旁的“帝王”机器腿部的照片

objectives.en: Break open the crashed probe by the Emperor's leg near Almatera Station
objectives.zh-CN: 破开阿尔玛特拉站附近“帝王”机器腿旁的坠毁探测器

objectives.en: Inspect the circuitry in the probe
objectives.zh-CN: 检查“探测器”内部电路

objectives.en: Analyze the exposed area on top of the Emperor's leg near Railroad Junction
objectives.zh-CN: 分析铁路站场枢纽附近“帝王”机器腿部顶端的外露区域

objectives.en: Reach the base of the Emperor
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达“帝王”机器底部

objectives.en: Search the Buried Harvester Payload
objectives.zh-CN: 搜寻埋藏的“收割者”空投

objectives.en: Deliver the ARC Conductive Coupler to Celeste
objectives.zh-CN: 将ARC导电耦合器交付给塞莱斯特

label.zh-CN: 任意完成2项:

description.en: All of Speranza is buzzing about Stella Montis right now, and I admit it’s caught my attention. Let the others sort out the whats and hows; I’m interested in the tech inside.
description.zh-CN: 现在整个斯佩兰扎都在热议星辰山，我承认这也引起了我的注意。让其他人去搞清楚它的来龙去脉好了，我感兴趣的是里面的科技。

objectives.en: Take a Photo of any of the Rovers in the Sandbox
objectives.zh-CN: 拍摄沙盘中任意探测车的照片

objectives.en: Search the papers in the Security Checkpoint room by the Lobby
objectives.zh-CN: 在大厅的安全检查站中寻找文件

objectives.en: Deliver a Magnetron to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将磁控管交给天玟

objectives.en: Deliver a Flow Controller to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将流量控制器交给天玟

description.en: Shotgun engagements against drones offer a useful test of stopping power. Concentrating the full charge into a single projectile could produce far more decisive results.
description.zh-CN: 用霰弹枪打无人机是测试阻滞力的好方法。将全部弹药汇聚成单发弹丸，效果应该会更具颠覆性。

objectives.en: Destroy 50 Flying ARC using shotguns
objectives.zh-CN: 使用霰弹枪摧毁50个空中ARC

label.zh-CN: 使用霰弹枪摧毁50个空中ARC

description.en: Those androids around Stella Montis… It seems they were test subjects as much as they were assistants. There’s some encrypted research notes about a… Project Pathos.
description.zh-CN: 星辰山周边的那些机器人……与其说它们是助手，不如说也是实验对象。有一些加密的研究笔记，提到一个……“悲怆计划”。

objectives.en: Scan any Android on Stella Montis
objectives.zh-CN: 扫描星辰山的任意机器人

objectives.en: Find the Android in Research Lab 3 in the Medical Bay
objectives.zh-CN: 在医疗区3号研究实验室找到机器人

objectives.en: Reach the Control Room in the Western Tunnels and search for clues
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达西部隧道的控制室并搜寻线索

description.en: I’m not saying our water’s been tampered with, but based on your samples, I can’t rule out the possibility either. Would you return to the Dam and see what’s wrong?
description.zh-CN: 我不是说我们的水源被动了手脚，但根据你带回来的样本，也不能排除这种可能性。能否返回大坝，查清楚哪里出了问题？

objectives.en: Reach the Water Treatment Building in The Dam
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达大坝的水处理厂大楼

objectives.en: Search for the Flood Spill Intake near the Swamp
objectives.zh-CN: 在沼泽附近搜索溢洪道进水口

objectives.en: Investigate any suspicious objects
objectives.zh-CN: 调查任何可疑物品

description.en:
Those Hornet stings can really mess you up, if you’re unlucky. And even if you destroy one, you’re still wasting a ton of ammo.

I’ve been working on a more elegant way to bring them down. Care to make some sparks fly?
description.zh-CN:
运气不好的话，那些“马蜂”够你喝一壶的。就算运气好能摧毁一架，也要浪费一大堆弹药。

我一直在研究更优雅的方法来干掉它们。能不能帮我验证一下？

objectives.en: Destroy a Hornet using any Grenade
objectives.zh-CN: 使用任意手雷摧毁1个“马蜂”

objectives.en: Destroy a Hornet with a Trigger 'Nade or Snap Blast
objectives.zh-CN: 用触发式手雷或闪爆手雷摧毁1架“马蜂”

label.en: Destroy a Hornet with a Trigger 'Nade or Snap Blast
label.zh-CN: 用触发式手雷或闪爆手雷摧毁1架“马蜂”

description.en: Fast movement is useful right up until a weapon needs to come into play. A weapon that keeps up with the pace would be useful.
description.zh-CN: 高速移动很实用，但拔枪射击时就麻烦了。要是有一把能跟上快节奏移动的武器就好了。

objectives.en: Visit the Electrical Substation
objectives.zh-CN: 前往变电站

objectives.en: Visit the Truck Stop
objectives.zh-CN: 前往卡车停靠站

objectives.en: Visit the Old Town
objectives.zh-CN: 前往老城区

objectives.en: Visit the Almatera Station
objectives.zh-CN: 前往阿尔玛特拉站

objectives.en: Visit the Researcher Lodgings
objectives.zh-CN: 前往研究员住所区

objectives.en: Visit the Deep-Space Telescope
objectives.zh-CN: 前往深空望远镜

objectives.en: Visit the Commissary Supermarket
objectives.zh-CN: 前往军需超市

label.zh-CN: 前往彭多拉山口的7处地点

description.en: You like a certain amount of uncertainty, right? A client wants the contents of a locked safe in Stella Montis. It's intact, so whatever's inside has been there since before the Exodus. Interested?
description.zh-CN: 你喜欢一定程度的未知因素，对吧？有客户想要星辰山中一个上锁保险柜里的东西。那个柜子完好无损，所以里面的东西在“离巢时代”之前就一直存放在那儿了。有兴趣吗？

objectives.en: Go to the Security Bridge
objectives.zh-CN: 前往安保区过道桥

objectives.en: Search for the safe in the side room by the third-floor staircases
objectives.zh-CN: 在三楼楼梯旁的侧室中搜寻保险柜

objectives.en: Head upstairs to the fourth-floor control room
objectives.zh-CN: 上楼前往四楼控制室

objectives.en: Use the Access Card Printer to print a key to the safe
objectives.zh-CN: 使用门禁卡打印机打印保险柜钥匙

objectives.en: Search for alternate ways into the safe
objectives.zh-CN: 寻找进入保险柜的其他路径

objectives.en: Retrieve the contents of the safe
objectives.zh-CN: 取回保险柜内的物品

objectives.en: Deliver the Project Heartwood Blueprints to Tian Wen
objectives.zh-CN: 将“常青计划”蓝图交给天玟

description.en: Back during the First Wave, my squad and I built a trap out by the Dam. Overloaded a generator, turned it into a makeshift ARC trap. Now I hear Raiders are using it to cut comms and spring ambushes on each other. I need you to end it.
description.zh-CN: “第一波”期间，我们小队在大坝边上设了一个陷阱，就是把发电机超载，当成临时的ARC诱捕器。现在听说奇袭者之间用它来切断通讯打伏击。你帮我去毁了它。

objectives.en: Reach Victory Ridge
objectives.zh-CN: 抵达凯旋岭

objectives.en: Find the old EMP trap
objectives.zh-CN: 找到旧的电磁脉冲陷阱

objectives.en: Disable the first power switch
objectives.zh-CN: 关闭第一个电源开关

objectives.en: Disable the second power switch
objectives.zh-CN: 关闭第二个电源开关

objectives.en: Disable the third power switch
objectives.zh-CN: 关闭第三个电源开关

objectives.en: Shut down the EMP trap
objectives.zh-CN: 关闭电磁脉冲陷阱

description.en: There is a reservoir beneath the Spaceport; if we manage to route that water here, that should buy us time to deal with the contamination.
description.zh-CN: 太空港下面有一个水库。如果能把那里的水引到这里来，就能为我们争取一些时间来解决污染问题。

objectives.en: Find the tunnels under the Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 找到太空港下面的隧道

objectives.en: Find and turn the valve in the tunnels under Spaceport
objectives.zh-CN: 到太空港下面的隧道中找到并转动阀门

description.en: On the surface, our paths seldom cross by design. After all, your presence draws more eyes than ours can afford.
description.zh-CN: 在地表，我们很少刻意相遇。毕竟，你的出现会引来太多目光，是我们承受不起的。

objectives.en: On Stella Montis, take a photo of the sculpture in the Atrium
objectives.zh-CN: 在星辰山，拍摄中庭雕塑的照片

objectives.en: On Spaceport, take a photo of a Baron Husk
objectives.zh-CN: 在太空港拍摄“男爵”残骸的照片

objectives.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, ping a Bombardier
objectives.zh-CN: 在大坝战场，标记一个“投弹手”

objectives.en: On Buried City, ping a Bastion
objectives.zh-CN: 在掩埋废城，标记一台“堡垒”

objectives.en: Deliver 3 Industrial Batteries to the Nomadic Envoy
objectives.zh-CN: 将3个工业级电池交付给游牧使团

description.en: Even the toughest machines have their weak spots. Consistent strikes against vulnerable components could reveal a way to develop rounds that hit them where it hurts most. Metaphorically speaking.
description.zh-CN: 再坚固的机械也有弱点。持续打击脆弱部件，或许能研发出专攻要害的弹药。这只是打个比方而已。

objectives.en: Destroy 40 thrusters on flying ARC enemies
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁40个空中ARC敌人的推进器

label.zh-CN: 靶向部件试验

description.en: Hey, question for you. What do you get if you cross a Hornet and Fireball? If your answer is ‘a Firefly’, then we’re on the same page.
description.zh-CN: 问你个问题，“马蜂”和“火球”结合会是什么？如果你的答案是“萤火虫”，那我们想到一块儿去了。

objectives.en: Deliver a Hornet Driver to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 将“马蜂”引擎交给阿波罗

objectives.en: Deliver a Fireball Burner to Apollo
objectives.zh-CN: 把“火球”燃烧炉交给阿波罗

objectives.en: Destroy a Firefly
objectives.zh-CN: 摧毁一个“萤火虫”

Kids around here have been kicking empty grenade casings around. It’s only a matter of time before they’re not so empty.

So here’s the plan. You help me with some prep work, and I’ll set up an actual football team for the young ones.

description.en:
I have another job. It’s.. about my mom.

Those First Wave sites I sent you to before? I actually hoped you’d find something of my mother’s. She fought in the Raider resistance. It was a long shot; but now I've got an actual lead.
description.zh-CN:
我还有个任务，是关于……我母亲的。

之前我派你去那些“第一波”遗址，其实是希望你能找到我母亲的某样东西，她曾作为奇袭者反抗军战斗过。我知道希望很渺茫，但这次我找到了可靠的线索。

There's no such thing as junk, to a Raider; just valuable materials waiting to be recycled.

If you're going to amount to anything around here, you can't just wait for things to be served on a silver platter.

description.zh-CN: 托雷多暗道官方管理层要求我们提供一根能量管，以供他们使用“自己的”弹射管道。不要被他们的名字骗了，他们根本不是什么官方，只是一群手握大权的恶霸。能帮我解决这个问题吗？
